Name: Application foundation
Exit gate: Review PR #2 and retain test evidence; do not infer production readiness.

Name: Account and security foundation
Exit gate: Account recovery, MFA, regression security tests and retained CI evidence pass.

Name: Verified crypto sandbox
Outcome: A test payment unlocks exactly one purchase
Exit gate: Testnet invoice authorization, atomic 98/2 split, confirmation and reconciliation pass; no mainnet.

Name: Creator-owned media
Outcome: Upload and deliver private images and video
Exit gate: Private storage and media authorization tested, including deletion and interrupted uploads.

Name: Membership commerce
Outcome: Subscriptions as prepaid access plus paid posts and tips
Exit gate: Access periods, purchases, tips, pricing, member library and cancellations work with verified settlement.

Name: Conditional content safeguards
Outcome: Lawful restricted-content workflows without adult-only branding
Exit gate: Applicable verification, consent, reporting, notices and removal workflows approved and tested.

Name: Turnkey private beta
Outcome: A creator deploys and recovers their own site
Exit gate: Guided installation, domain/HTTPS, upgrades, restores and beta onboarding succeed on supported hosts.

Name: Production release gate
Exit gate: All applicable launch gates signed off; no unresolved security finding above Low; release artifact and rollback verified.

Name: Creator growth
Outcome: Improve discovery within each creator site and retention
Exit gate: Choose features from pilot evidence; carry forward security, privacy and content boundaries.

Name: Optional ecosystem
Outcome: Expand only with a supported business case
Exit gate: Architecture and compatibility review before new networks, extensions or major platform changes.
